rci1_using_msad.detail: Multi-site; 11 datasets combined (10 publicly available cross-sectional datasets from different institutions + 1 longitudinal clinical dataset from Utrecht with two scanners)
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "Eleven datasets were combined to create the full sample." "We included healthy participants from ten publicly available datasets: the Amsterdam Open MRI Collection (aomic) (id1000, piop1 and piop2) datasets, the Cambridge Centre for Ageing and Neuroscience (camcan) dataset, the Dallas Longitudinal Brain Study (dlbs) dataset, the Information eXtraction from Images (ixi) dataset, the Narratives (narratives) dataset, the Open Access Series of Imaging Studies (oasis3) dataset, the NKI-Rockland (rockland) dataset and the Southwest University adult lifespan (sald) dataset." "Two identical scanners were used"
rci1_using_msad.location: Janssen2024.pdf.md: Materials and Methods / Sample, L54

rci2_using_epd.detail: Cam-CAN, IXI, OASIS, and NKI-Rockland (all EPDs) were used among the 10 publicly available datasets for normative model training
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "the Cambridge Centre for Ageing and Neuroscience (camcan) dataset, ... the Information eXtraction from Images (ixi) dataset (http://braindevelopment.org/ixidataset/), ... the Open Access Series of Imaging Studies (oasis3) dataset, the NKI-Rockland (rockland) dataset"
rci2_using_epd.location: Janssen2024.pdf.md: Materials and Methods / Sample, L54

rci3_epd_name.detail: camcan = Cam-CAN; ixi = IXI; oasis3 = OASIS; rockland = NKI (NKI-Rockland). Other public datasets (AOMIC, DLBS, Narratives, SALD) are not in the EPD list.
rci3_epd_name.supporting_text: "the Cambridge Centre for Ageing and Neuroscience (camcan) dataset, ... the Information eXtraction from Images (ixi) dataset, ... the Open Access Series of Imaging Studies (oasis3) dataset, the NKI-Rockland (rockland) dataset"
rci3_epd_name.location: Janssen2024.pdf.md: Materials and Methods / Sample, L54

rci5_n.detail: Training phase HC only; pooled from ~90% of each of the 10 publicly available datasets and ~20% of HC from the clinical dataset
rci5_n.supporting_text: "The training set included 4310 participants and the test set 859 participants." "only healthy controls were included in the training set"
rci5_n.location: Janssen2024.pdf.md: Materials and Methods / Normative modeling of morphometric similarity, L117

rci6_sex.detail: Training phase; sex breakdown for the training set (N=4310) is not directly reported. Estimated from per-dataset sex distributions (Fig. 1 table) weighted by approximate training contribution (~90% of each public dataset, ~20% of clinical HC N=292). Stratified split preserved sex distributions.
rci6_sex.supporting_text: "The per-dataset splits were created using the createDataPartition function from the caret R package, preserving the distribution of age, sex, and scanner ... in both the training and the test split of each dataset."
rci6_sex.location: Janssen2024.pdf.md: Fig. 1 table; Materials and Methods / Normative modeling of morphometric similarity, L117

rci7_age.detail: Training phase; age statistics for the training set (N=4310) are not directly reported. Weighted mean and combined SD computed from per-dataset statistics (Fig. 1 table and Table 1A) weighted by approximate training contribution (~90% of each public dataset, ~20% of clinical HC). Combined SD accounts for both within-dataset and between-dataset variance. Min/max not reported for the overall training set. Age in years.
rci7_age.supporting_text: "The per-dataset splits were created using the createDataPartition function from the caret R package, preserving the distribution of age, sex, and scanner ... in both the training and the test split of each dataset." Per-dataset ages ranged from mean 21.92 (SD 1.79-4.66) for AOMIC/Narratives to mean 69.44 (SD 8.75) for OASIS3.
rci7_age.location: Janssen2024.pdf.md: Fig. 1 table; Table 1A; Materials and Methods / Normative modeling of morphometric similarity, L117
